source.title: New WMT Leader Chosen
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Somya Srivastava has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Marketing Team (WMT).

Somya was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Somya the best of luck in fulfilling her new duty!

Somya Srivastava was the only applicant for the position. Her candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vZ4NrK40KENKUMP13H8VkoiSttHjmLxr) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组新负责人确定
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Somya Srivastava 已获任命，担任 WCA 市场营销组（WMT）负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的 [10.2019.0 号议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Somya，并经现任委员会、团队负责人及高级代表投票批准。

祝 Somya 履新顺利！

Somya Srivastava 是本岗位的唯一申请人。如有兴趣，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vZ4NrK40KENKUMP13H8VkoiSttHjmLxr)查看她的申请材料。
